title: Cloud-First Autopilot Zero-Touch Provisioning (Entra Join, Optional Later Domain Join)
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (zero-touch provisioning model: Entra-join + Autopilot first, optional later domain join; reduces technician effort; spans Autopilot/Entra/Intune, hybrid considerations).
Distinct from windows-autopilot (general Autopilot); this is the cloud-first-then-optional-hybrid + near-zero-touch technician-effort model. version_directive: New; branding: off.
hook: Power on, walk away — provision Windows cloud-first with Autopilot, domain-join only if you must
problem: Hybrid provisioning drags: technicians babysit each build, juggle domain join, and handle too much by hand. The modern path is cloud-first — Entra join + Windows Autopilot so a device provisions itself the moment it's powered on, with domain join added afterward only if a specific app or resource truly requires it. This solution delivers that near zero-touch model: Autopilot profiles, the Enrollment Status Page, app/policy delivery at provisioning, and a clean decision path for the rare case that still needs on-prem domain join — so technicians do almost nothing.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the cloud-first provisioning model (Entra join + Autopilot), why it beats hybrid-by-default, the zero-touch experience (ESP, app/policy at enrollment), and the decision criteria for adding domain join later only when required.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune, Entra ID, Windows Autopilot, hardware-hash/registration path, the Enrollment Status Page, app/baseline set, a pilot group) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: register devices, build the Autopilot deployment profile (Entra join), configure the Enrollment Status Page and provisioning-time apps/policies, validate the zero-touch flow, define the optional later-domain-join path, then pilot, validate, and expand.

5 PowerShell scripts — Autopilot/enrollment readiness discovery, provisioning/enrollment validation, a provisioning-success and technician-touch report, safe remediation of failed provisioning, and an Autopilot target-group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: A near zero-touch cloud-first provisioning model — Entra join + Windows Autopilot so devices provision on power-on, with domain join added later only if truly required — so technicians do almost nothing. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
short_plain: A near zero-touch cloud-first provisioning model — Entra join + Windows Autopilot so devices provision on power-on, with domain join added later only if truly required.
meta_description: Provision Windows cloud-first with Entra join + Autopilot for near zero-touch deployment, adding domain join later only if required: Autopilot profiles, Enrollment Status Page, provisioning-time apps. Self-guided, tested steps and scripts.
bottom_line: Windows devices that provision themselves on power-on — Entra-joined via Autopilot with apps and policy applied at enrollment, domain join only where truly required — cutting technician effort to almost nothing, proven on a pilot before you scale.
